title: Tofu pineapple herb salad
summary: Tofu pineapple herb salad is a thai dinner built around firm tofu and pineapple, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook firm tofu for Tofu pineapple herb salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cucumber alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss pineapple with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.
Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Tofu pineapple herb salad straight away. Taste Tofu pineapple herb salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
